outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/table of breast anatomy and cancer classification, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating the study aim, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method, not a data plot.
The data is shown as line/time-series traces of individual model recordings, not as averaged bar data; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
The growth quantification is a line plot of cell number over days per model, not an averaged bar chart; line plots are exempt.
The dose-response curves are line plots showing growth inhibition per model, exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Panel H contains gene expression and mutation heatmaps, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
The PCA and 3D parameter plots are scatter plots where individual dots already represent individual cell line data points; no averaging is depicted.
